title: Gaulteram - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Gaulteram in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Gaulteram is a earth-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Agility (B), Luck (C).

sections.title: Is the Gaulteram Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (B), Luck (C). A dedicated earth pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
